chunks: And by this chain of narrators, from Muhammad ibn Uthman, he said: Narrated to us Ahmad ibn Abi Khaithama, he said: Narrated to us Yahya ibn Ma'in, he said: Narrated to us Abdullah ibn Salih, he said: Narrated to us Al-Layth ibn Sa'd from Khalid ibn Yazid from Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal from Rabi'ah ibn Saif, he said: We were with Shafi Al-Asbahi, and he said: I heard Abdullah ibn Umar say: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) say:
After me, there will be twelve Caliphs.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the number of his successors?
ai.summary: This narration, cited by Shaykh al-Tusi in *Kitab al-Ghayba* from the companion Abdullah ibn Umar, serves as a foundational proof for the Twelver Shia doctrine of the twelve Imams by linking the prophetic prediction directly to the caliphal lineage. It highlights the convergence of Sunni and Shia sources on this specific number, reinforcing the legitimacy of the Imams as the rightful successors. The hadith is often interpreted in light of the twelve tribes of Israel, emphasizing a structured, divinely appointed leadership.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 94 - It is narrated from the same chain of narrators from Muhammad bin Uthman that: Narrated to us Ahmad bin Abi Khaithama that: Narrated to us Yahya bin Moin that: Narrated to us Abdullah bin Salih that: Narrated to us Laith bin Saad from Khalid bin Yazid from Saeed bin Abi Hilal from Rabia bin Saif that: I was with Shafi Asbahi when he said: I heard Abdullah bin Umar say: I heard the Messenger of Allah (s) say:
After me, there would be twelve Caliphs.
